decisions.rationale: The shared authenticated app shell owns transport-to-presentation composition for both app roles. It connects the FCM service callback to the public foreground notification controller command seam; delivery occurs outside provider construction, the service checks session generations, and the controller validates recipient, role and foreground state. Shell, FCM lifecycle and foreground notification tests cover delivery and account changes.

Sign-out is the app-session boundary and invalidates the keepAlive Explore browse roots so a new account cannot inherit the prior account's filters. The focused AuthSessionController test proves reset behavior.

Sign-out is the app-session boundary and invalidates the keepAlive Explore browse roots so a new account cannot inherit the prior account's search query. The focused AuthSessionController test proves reset behavior.

Sign-out is the app-session boundary and must reset the public onboarding controller plus its Mutations. This is the documented controller-to-controller command seam, not a read-model or widget dependency.

Sign-out is the app-session boundary and invalidates the keepAlive Explore browse roots so a new account cannot inherit the prior account's selected city. The focused AuthSessionController test proves reset behavior.

Sign-out is the app-session boundary and invalidates the keepAlive Explore browse roots so a new account cannot inherit the prior account's manual city-selection guard. The focused AuthSessionController test proves reset behavior.

Host composes the canonical Chat live read model through the annotated, narrowly exported lib/chats/chats.dart API, then adds account-scoped historical pages. Chat retains preview identity and live-window ownership; Host rechecks each older match's current membership before projecting it into organizer-authorized person collections. This is the sanctioned public read-model seam, not a dependency on sibling widgets or a second Chat subscription implementation. Chat projection, Host person identity, conversation revocation and pagination tests cover the constituent contracts; dependency-direction and topology checks enforce the exact public edge and reject cycles or stale decisions.

Program creation currently watches the Host organizer selection to invalidate an in-flight account/organizer command when the actor changes. CAT156 will replace this presentation-to-presentation edge with an injected or feature-neutral actor fence while preserving draft retention, idempotency, and override contracts.

The Programs inventory controller currently watches the Host organizer selection to reject stale pages and mutations after an actor switch. CAT156 will replace this presentation-to-presentation edge with an injected or feature-neutral actor fence while preserving account and organizer isolation.
Account deletion completes through the public auth-session command seam so auth and onboarding flow state are cleared centrally. Moving that cleanup into Safety would duplicate session ownership.

These eight dependencies belong to one sign-out boundary: auth repository, auth and onboarding flow controllers, four session-scoped Explore browse roots, and the existing FCM service. Installation removal runs while account authorization is still valid, without initializing an unused service; flow state is cleared centrally. Auth session and FCM lifecycle tests cover cleanup, in-flight sign-out deduplication and bounded unregister failure.

The eight dependencies form one route projection: conversation, match and host-inquiry context, event/profile enrichment, share capability, and action pending state. The provider has no cycles and prevents the screen from assembling those waves itself.

The eight dependencies form one Event Detail route projection: auth resolution, event and organizer authority, viewer profile, reviews, saved state, participation, and organizer membership. Their loading and error precedence is intentionally centralized so Event Detail and its map route cannot render inconsistent visibility or viewer actions.

The eighteen dependencies are a cohesive discovery aggregate spanning filters, viewer eligibility, memberships, participations, saves, internal and external supply, search, and club names. Splitting now would duplicate partial-loading and precedence logic; revisit if a second route needs a stable subset or fan-out rises above twenty.

The route-scoped Program creation controller landed with a manual family so its value-equality request key, auto-dispose lifecycle, future access, and focused overrides stay stable. CAT156 owns the equivalent Riverpod codegen migration and generated-output update.

The Program creation command journal remains manually provided for the initial consolidation so its persistence instance and test override contract do not change in the source repair. CAT156 owns the equivalent Riverpod codegen migration.

The account- and organizer-scoped Programs inventory controller landed with a manual family so its request identity, disposal, pagination, and override contracts stay stable. CAT156 owns the equivalent Riverpod codegen migration and generated-output update.
